title: Machine Learning–Enabled Smartphone CRISPR-Cas12a Lateral Flow Platform for Sensitive Detection of Circulating HPV DNA
authors: Jipei Liao; Jesse Rima; Aarush Sharma; Jen-Hui Tsou; Feng Jiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习增强智能手机CRISPR-LFA平台检测血浆HPV DNA，属核酸检测应用，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA机制研究，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer and other HPV-related malignancies. Effective screening and early detection of HPV, particularly in point-of-care (POC) settings, can reduce disease progression and associated mortality. Although PCR-based assays provide high sensitivity, their dependence on centralized laboratory infrastructure limits accessibility in POC settings. CRISPR-Cas diagnostics enable programmable, isothermal detection of HPV with lateral flow assay (LFA) readouts; however, visual interpretation of faint bands can be subjective and inconsistent. Our objective was to develop a machine learning (ML)-enhanced, smartphone-native CRISPR-LFA platform for highly sensitive and reliable detection of HPV DNA in plasma. A smartphone-based diagnostic system integrating CRISPR-LFA with a ML framework was developed using standardized image acquisition within a light-controlled enclosure. Radiomics-inspired strip features were extracted and analyzed using a multivariable logistic regression model. A total of 150 plasma samples were used for model development and 60 independent samples for validation. An optimized model was developed that had 96.7% sensitivity and 100% specificity for detection of HPV DNA. The smartphone-enabled CRISPR platform demonstrated higher sensitivity than visual interpretation, particularly for faint-band results, and reduced false positives. Validation in the independent cohort confirmed the robustness of the assay. Performance remained stable across smartphone models, lighting conditions, and operators, and on-device inference enabled reliable operation. In sum, the smartphone-integrated CRISPR-LFA platform can facilitate accurate and reliable detection of plasma HPV DNA in POC settings and has the potential to enhance early detection, prevention, and treatment of cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的持续感染是宫颈癌及其他HPV相关恶性肿瘤的主要原因。有效的筛查和HPV早期检测，尤其是在即时检测（POC）环境中，可以减少疾病进展及相关死亡率。尽管基于PCR的检测方法具有高灵敏度，但其对集中化实验室基础设施的依赖限制了其在POC环境中的可及性。CRISPR-Cas诊断技术能够实现对HPV的可编程、等温检测，并采用侧向层析试纸（LFA）读取结果；然而，对微弱条带的视觉判读可能具有主观性和不一致性。我们的目标是开发一种机器学习（ML）增强的、智能手机原生CRISPR-LFA平台，用于对血浆中HPV DNA进行高灵敏度和可靠检测。本研究开发了一种将CRISPR-LFA与ML框架整合的基于智能手机的诊断系统，并在光控封闭环境中采用标准化图像采集。提取了放射组学启发的试纸条特征，并使用多变量逻辑回归模型进行分析。共使用150份血浆样本进行模型开发，60份独立样本用于验证。优化后的模型对HPV DNA检测的灵敏度为96.7%，特异性为100%。该智能手机支持的CRISPR平台在检测中表现出比视觉判读更高的灵敏度，尤其是对微弱条带结果，并减少了假阳性。独立队列中的验证确认了该检测方法的稳健性。性能在不同智能手机型号、光照条件和操作人员之间保持稳定，且设备端推理实现了可靠操作。总之，智能手机集成的CRISPR-LFA平台能够在POC环境中促进血浆HPV DNA的准确可靠检测，并具有增强宫颈癌早期发现、预防和治疗的潜力。
